<div class="card-body">
'''The Bith Shuffle''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ビス・シャッフル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のプレイヤーのリザーブデッキ、ロストデッキ、ユーズドデッキのいずれかをシャッフルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-115o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">フィグリン・ダン・アンド・モーダル・ノーズ楽団は、カンティーナで演奏している。ルークが到着したとき、彼らはお気に入りの曲、“僕に夢中”を演奏中だった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Bith Shuffle.

'''Card text:''' Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck, Lost Pile, or Used Pile.

'''Lore:''' Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes are playing at the Cantina. When Luke arrived they were playing their favorite song, “Mad About Me.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[The Bith Shuffle]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
